name: Professional services
description: Accountants, solicitors, consultants, agencies. Built around a longer consultative cycle where the proposal, not the quote, is the decision point.

taskTemplates.title: Send engagement letter and onboarding pack

sequences.name: Enquiry to discovery call
sequences.description: Moves a new enquiry towards a booked conversation.

steps.bodyTemplate:
Hi {{contact.firstName}},

Thank you for getting in touch. The most useful next step is usually a short call to understand what you are trying to achieve.

Reply with a couple of times that suit you and we will get it booked.

Hi {{contact.firstName}},

Following up on my note earlier this week. If now is not the right time, that is completely fine — just let me know and I will leave it there.

Otherwise, send over a time that works and we will find a slot.

sequences.name: Proposal follow-up
sequences.description: Runs after a proposal is sent. Three touches over two weeks, ending with a clear close-out.

steps.bodyTemplate:
Hi {{contact.firstName}},

Just checking whether you had any questions about the proposal.

Happy to talk through the scope or adjust it if something does not fit.

Hi {{contact.firstName}},

Checking in on the proposal. If priorities have shifted, no problem at all — it would just help to know either way.

Hi {{contact.firstName}},

I will close this off for now so it stops sitting in your inbox.

If it becomes relevant again, reply to this and we will pick it straight back up.

forms.name: Enquiry
forms.successMessage: Thanks — we have your enquiry and will be in touch shortly.
forms.consentText: By submitting this form you agree that we may contact you by email and phone about your enquiry. You can ask us to stop at any time.

operatorNotes: The Proposal follow-up sequence ends with an explicit close-out message rather than trailing off. It performs better than an indefinite chase and it is the more honest thing to send.
The conflict check field is a prompt, not a control. This system does not perform conflict checking and cannot block work on that basis.
All sequences are created as drafts. Review the wording in your own voice before activating.
